newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan utilities Sept elec supply rises 2.4% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan utilities Sept elec supply rises 2.4% yr/yr.

text.p: Electricity supplied by Japan's nine main power utilities in September rose 2.4 percent from a year earlier to 67.9 billion kilowatt hours (kWh), an industry body said on Friday.
The rise was partly due to greater use of air conditioners, the Federation of Electric Power Companies said.
Electricity generation by nuclear power plants in September fell because of maintenance checks at some plants, it said.
Nuclear power generation fell 6.2 percent from a year earlier to 20.8 billion kWh.
Utilisation of nuclear power facilities was 75 percent, down 5.3 points.
Thermal power generation in September increased to meet the shortfall in nuclear power supplies, and was up 8.9 percent at 33.9 billion kWh.
Electricity generated by hydraulic power in September totalled 5.2 billion kWh, 8.6 percent higher than a year earlier, it said.
